title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Image Exceeds 5 MB Size Limit breaks session for subsequent text prompts. Also breaks --continue mode if exit/re-enter.
body:
**Bug Description**
I'm pasting a moderately sized image with ctrl-v into claude code under iterm2 on macos 26, it doesn't happen all the time but now the session is broken showing this error below even for text followup prompts. I'm using 1.0.124 recent and latest available Claude Code
